ModMetaData.name: World Tech Level - Final Guard
ModMetaData.author: Allen
ModMetaData.description: Final-generation compatibility guard for World Tech Level on RimWorld 1.5. Re-validates generated pawn equipment, apparel, inventory, prosthetics/implants, traits and xenotypes; filters generated item sets and trader stock; and adds late quest/incident gates. Designed to catch content injected by other mods after World Tech Level's normal generation filters have already run. No per-tick scanning.
